description: This file defines and extends a Heading node for a rich text editor, including attributes, commands, input rules, node view, and a plugin for handling heading-related behaviors such as collapsing sections and updating node attributes.

classes.name: Heading
classes.description: A custom extension of the Tiptap Heading node with added attributes, commands, input rules, node view, and plugin for collapsible headings.

methods.name: toggleNodesUnderPos
methods.description: Toggles the visibility (hidden attribute) of nodes under a heading at a given position, optionally collapsing or expanding sections.
